text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Administration of Muslim Law (Certification Mark) Notification.
2. The MUIS Halal Certification Mark set out in the Schedule shall be a certification mark of the Majlis.

THE SCHEDULE
MUIS Halal Certification Mark
[G.N. No. S 335/2005]
